recoverable_equivalent_risk_unit.definition: absolute unleveraged price distance from entry to the initial stop
recoverable_equivalent_risk_unit.pnl_fraction_of_margin_approximation: pnl_on_margin_fraction = roe before fees and funding

examples.interpretation: A 2% adverse price move at 20x produces approximately -40% ROE; it is not a 40% price move.
The same -40% ROE stop is twice as wide in price at 10x as at 20x.
The 8% ROE trigger corresponds to 40 bps favorable price movement; the configured stop offset locks approximately 30 bps before execution costs.

reason: A future D1A-based experiment must bind leverage per entry and choose whether R means the historical leveraged initial stop, a fixed price-risk unit, or another explicitly preregistered unit. The audit cannot make that choice.
